summary: Deduplicated discussion signals: major model releases (Gemini 4 Neon), vendor product deltas (Anthropic Claude Code), multiple operator field reports on MCP/sandbox issues and agent ops, plus infra primitives (Prismor, Codex Sandbox, Runtm). Prioritize security and operator checklists. | Vendor releases and security advisories: AWS Quick & SageMaker HyperPod updates, Microsoft Foundry GA, JetBrains IDE agent support, Cloudflare WAF guidance, OpenRouter-HuggingFace routing, several GHSA advisories on MCP/agent tooling. No vendor social/operator field reports in this shard. | GitHub OSS snapshot: mix of vendor releases (GitHub, Cloudflare, Qwen, Anthropic, OpenAI),high‑traction agent tooling (trycua/cua, open-agent-hub, dify), and infra primitives for agent eval, MCP and security. Many popular repos are single-source on GitHub — flag for social/announcements corroboration. | Package-shard: multiple agent-related releases and tooling packages detected (MCP servers, VS Code agent extensions, security tooling, infra crates). No social/operator reports in this shard; many items are single-source package listings requiring corroboration.
